_about: The office's settings, written by tools/make-office.py between the office:settings markers in netlify/cb/lib.mjs, the only copy the server reads. The pipelines and their stages are EspoCRM's, word for word and in its order (read 2026-10-20): each stage says which status it puts a grant request in, and the first stage of each is where a new one starts. Statuses are EspoCRM's three. Amounts are whole dollars, as EspoCRM held every one. Cases are EspoCRM's too: its two types (and Join Request, added here on 2026-10-22 for the Join form, which EspoCRM never had), its seven statuses in its order, each saying whether a case is still open, and its four priorities. The intake says what each of stimpunks.org's forms makes when the WPForms plugin posts an entry: its name's prefix, and a grant request's pipeline and amount or a case's type, as the plugin made them in EspoCRM. Since 2026-10-22 a form type may also name `task`, the id of one of the task templates in data/tasks.json: once the intake has made the record, it makes a task from that template, its {name}, {contact} and {case} or {grant} filled from the form (Ryan's ask, to make onboarding a new community member less manual). The Join form (`community`) makes a Join Request case, which is the office's copy of the form entry, and an onboarding task linking it and the contact. Since 2026-10-23 a case's form type may name `lists`: each the Join form's question asking for one of our mailing lists, word for word as the form labels it, and the tag Givebutter keeps that list under, so a director's press of Add them to Givebutter's lists on the join request sends their name, email and the tags of the lists they said yes to (Ryan's call, reversing Givebutter being read and never written; see privacy.html#givebutter-lists). Since 2026-10-23 a case's form type may also name `members`: stimpunks.org's Members page (its WordPress page id and address) and the Join form's questions asking for the words and the website for it, word for word as the form labels them, so a director can add the line they asked for to that page from the join request, after looking at it and tidying it (Ryan's ask; see privacy.html#members-page). And `organizations`: stimpunks.org's Organizations page, the Join form's questions for its words, website and logo, and the grounds its entries stand on, each a colour of stimpunks.org's theme by its slug and in words (read off the page and its theme on 2026-10-23), so a director can add the organization they asked for. Each also names the question for the name to show, which the form did not have on 2026-10-23: until it does, a person's line takes the name they gave on the form and an organization's name is typed, with their logo copied into stimpunks.org's media library (Ryan's ask; see privacy.html#organizations-page). Since 2026-10-23 every form type also names `form`, the WPForms form's own title on stimpunks.org (read there that day), so the dashboard's Form entries can say which form each entry came from (Ryan's ask).

Would you like to be added to our Monthly Newsletter mailing list?

members.words: Profile text for the Members page (optional)

organizations.name: Organization Name
organizations.words: Profile text for the Organizations page

_dashboard: dashboard: the operations dashboard's settings. active_cap is EspoCRM's 'Active Grant Applications (100 cap)': how many open grant requests submitted this calendar year each pipeline is capped at (Ryan, 2026-10-21: 100 per pipeline). Changing it is a line here and a run of tools/check-all.sh.
